verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a payments product with a Dashboard, but nothing in the evidence shows Terminal producing AI-generated insights or suggestions from merchant data. The MCP server and agent tooling are building blocks for external agents, Smart Disputes automates dispute evidence rather than generating insights, and on-reader tip suggestions are a customer-facing payment feature, not AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
